name: @prm/docs-site
description: Public Resource Map documentation site — narrative rendered from corpus/, diagrams compiled by archify.
//cookie: cookie@^2 is pinned here on purpose and is NOT used by this site. Astro's build imports named exports (parseCookie) from cookie@2, but Vite's module runner resolves bare specifiers from the PROJECT ROOT — and this monorepo hoists cookie@0.7.2 there, pulled in by express via @react-router/serve in ui/. Node's own resolution finds astro's nested copy correctly; Vite's does not, and the build dies with "Named export 'parseCookie' not found". A copy inside docs/node_modules is what makes the docs project root resolve v2. Removing this breaks `npm run docs` only, and only at the very end of the build.

scripts.predev: npm run sync-corpus && npm run diagrams
scripts.docs: npm run sync-corpus && npm run diagrams && npm run ref && astro build
